source: "guide 22.1 JobPacketSnapshot"
---
The versioned briefing for a job and visit; sections per [[HH-PKT-01]].

**Fields:** version; generated time; scope, SOP, hazard, resource and visit references; change summary against earlier versions; offline-download state per device.

**Invariants:** a new version on every relevant change; never contains access codes; acknowledgments and starts bind to a version and the current checks.

**Who may change:** generated by the server.
